name: Pricing Demo
dataset: Independent fictional demonstration / no real business information

series_mismatch_rows.title: Mosaic English B1 Premium Pack with Digital
Glasshouse English C1 Study Pack with Digital

challenges.label: Mislabelled collections
challenges.rule: Check the title prefix against the assigned product family. Investigate; never auto-correct the source.

challenges.label: Edition aliases
challenges.rule: Second Edition and 2nd Edition are parallel labels; make reporting alias without overwriting input.

challenges.label: False digital-access match
challenges.rule: Gleebook is a print resource name containing the substring ebook. Token-agnostic matching is unsafe.

challenges.label: Inconsistent bundle wording
challenges.rule: Study Pack with Digital and Study Pack + Online Access may require business validation before merging.

challenges.label: Taxonomy drift
challenges.rule: A Primary product is mistakenly labelled Secondary in the subsegment field.

challenges.label: Premium TB outlier
challenges.rule: TB is an ambiguous abbreviation and carries a price outlier; investigate, do not automatically exclude.

challenges.label: Incomplete access duration
challenges.rule: Only some products explicitly say 18 months; blank is unspecified, not unlimited.

challenges.label: Part A + B premium
challenges.rule: Buying parts individually costs more than a single full volume; compare only matched product families and levels.

challenges.label: Level-specific starter prices
challenges.rule: Starter differs from upper levels for two selected product families; may reflect strategy rather than error.

challenges.label: Answer support parity
challenges.rule: The solution-key pairs are the same fictional list price; verify matching on edition and level.
